commits.title: Ship smthrs-observe record format /7 with zero stale-pass holes

notes.text: Early strace-only recording missed syscalls past strace tables under keeper processes and struggled with io_uring race windows.

Rebuilt native observe.c (-Wall -Werror) for x86_64 and aarch64. Cleared all 7 ship blockers (u1, u2, u3, u4, u6, u7, u10) including ENOSYS io_uring_setup refusal and directory link counts. 100.00 percent coverage across all 4 observer modules.

notes.text: Round 1 surfaced 441 findings across 142 files (9 P0, 122 P1). Fuzz lanes uncovered tar duplicate-member symlink escapes, HTML XSS vectors, ReDoS in Workspace parsing, and credential leaks across quote boundaries.
18 deep passes across Codex Astra, Claude Fable/Opus, and Gemini Neon converged findings 441 -> 179 -> 82 (-81 percent, 0 P0s). 65 fuzz bugs found, 55 fixed.
